article.headline: Amarr Knox scores 26 as Alabama State holds off Southern 82-81, ending Jaguars' 10-game win streak
article.description: — Amarr Knox finished with 26 points to help Alabama State hold off Southern 82-81 on Monday night, ending the Jaguars' 10-game win streak.
article.linkText: Amarr Knox scores 26 as Alabama State holds off Southern 82-81, ending Jaguars' 10-game win streak
article.story: MONTGOMERY, Ala. -- — Amarr Knox finished with 26 points to help Alabama State hold off Southern 82-81 on Monday night, ending the Jaguars' 10-game win streak. Knox also had six assists for the Hornets (10-14, 6-5 Southwestern Athletic Conference). CJ Hines shot 7 for 15, including 4 for 9 from beyond the arc to add 19 points. Antonio Madlock had 18 points on 7-for-14 shooting. Cam Amboree finished with 17 points to lead the Jaguars (15-9, 10-1). Southern also got 12 points and nine rebounds from Dionjahe Thomas. Damariee Jones added 10 points, six rebounds and four blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
